svg.title: SAME VOLUME · Three designs at one material budget
svg.desc: Three finished local density-optimization runs with the same 40% target, mesh and boundary conditions. Carry and Conduct specialize. Share combines both load paths. Each performance ratio uses its own specialist as the reference.

g.title: Carry
g.desc: Minimize mechanical compliance. Relative mechanical compliance 1.00×. Relative thermal compliance 214×. Mean density 0.40000000.

g.title: Conduct
g.desc: Minimize thermal compliance. Relative mechanical compliance 4,716×. Relative thermal compliance 1.00×. Mean density 0.40000000.

g.title: Share
g.desc: Give both normalized objectives equal weight. Relative mechanical compliance 1.27×. Relative thermal compliance 1.59×. Mean density 0.40001309.
g.text: Give both normalized objectives equal weight
Three designs at one material budget
Each finished field uses the same 56 × 28 mesh and a target mean material density of 0.40.
Greater compliance means more displacement under the load or a greater temperature rise under the heat input.
Each ratio uses the corresponding specialist as 1.00×. Light cells are denser. Results are local SIMP designs.
